spans.s:
n. (-नं)
Shaking, agitation.
E.
धु to shake, affix ल्यु; also धूनन, &c.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Shaking, agitating.
E.
धु to shake, शानच् aff.

n. (-नं)
Shaking, agitating.
E.
धू to shake, affix ल्युट्.

f. (-निः)
A river; see the next.

f. (-नी)
A river.
E.
धु to go, affix नुक्, fem. affix ङीप्; the affix is sometimes considered as निक्, leaving नि, which makes धुनि ut sup.

f. (-निः)
Shaking, agitating.
E.
धू to agitate, affix क्तिन्, and त changed to न.

m. (-थः)
The ocean.
E.
धुनी, and नाथ lord.

m. (-रः)
1 The name of a sovereign; also named

An insect, (Coccinella.)
3 The smoke of a house.
4 A house lizard (?)
E.
धूम smoke reiterated, ऋ to go, affix अण्, deriv. irr.

mfn. (-न्वन्-न्वन्ती-न्वत्)
Shaking, agitating.
E.
धु to shake, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Shaking, agitating.
E.
धु to shake, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Distressed by heat or thirst.
2 Shaken, agitated.
E.
धू to shake, affix क्त, form irr.

m. (-कः)
Resin; it is sometimes read धूणक.
